alpha_review.background: The colored blur in fully transparent RGB has alpha0 and contributes no visible background. Pale and dark solid-background composites show no wide cast-shadow plate.

excluded_geometry: The pointed crown and small pyramidal post roofs are inclined surfaces, not horizontal ground-axis edges.
Ivy, moss, chipped rock and rune diagonals are organic or decorative silhouettes, not rigid axis measurements.

provenance.reuse: Only the original first forest illustration is copied losslessly; no other stage artwork is imported. Runtime uses a measured geometric remapping and uniform packing, without painting new stones.

generation.prompt: Upstream world-materials/provenance.json records the generator and orthographic +/-30 ground camera; the exact historical generation prompt is not recorded there. No new generation prompt was used for this reuse.
